Mira: Quick thread — follow-up to the precision profiles RFC. Two unresolved items: fast runtime contract for bitpath resolution, and a compact schema for reason codes we can expose to customers. Thoughts?

Sam: Runtime constraint first: the lookup on the hot path must be a single fixed-size struct read (no allocs, no JSON). Suggest a 16-byte fingerprint struct: u64 id, u32 mask, u32 fallback. Keep it mmap-friendly.

Ethan: Agree. Also proposal: treat allowed_bitpaths as a bitmask where bits are (fp8_head, fp8_body, int8, 4bit). That keeps reasoning simple and compact.

Lina: Product asks for transparent reason codes in responses. Recommend stable short keys: latency_budget, quality_gate, customer_pin, capacity_fallback, shadow_accepted. SDKs can map to UX strings.

Mira: For backward compatibility — Dedicated/Private customers may not get frequent control-plane updates. Should we ship signed offline bundles that contain fingerprint + manifest + compat map? Runtime uses only the fingerprint table.

Sam: Yes. Bundle must be signed and include a monotonic version. Runtime should validate signature at import time. For hot runtime reads, only use the compiled fingerprint blob.

Ethan: Ops: include a fail-open field per profile version: allowed fallback (e.g., int8) or model-id fallback. Also allow a shadow_sampling_rate to mint quality tokens for later evaluation.

Lina: UX: expose x-precision-applied, x-precision-reason, and x-precision-fingerprint headers. Keep values short. Console can resolve codes to explanations via fingerprint lookup.

Mira: Action items: Sam will draft C header + mmap layout. Ethan will propose bit assignments for the mask and a compact reason-code enum. Lina will draft header names and example screenshots. I'll combine into a follow-up PR.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: fp8-profile-v1 -> 1% at 2026-04-04T02:00Z :rocket:

Mira: Thanks all — quick sync tomorrow 10am to sign off.
